ruling.recommended_action: Apply a $6.74 voucher refund to the rider for the unexempted second off-route segment (F4) and record the driver's RD-1 shortest-route breach.

segment_findings.reason: RD-5: driver proposed the re-route via Kranji Expressway before deviating (chat 18:37, F8) and rider agreed at 18:38 (F9), earlier than the segment start 18:40; change made with prior mutual agreement, so not a deviation.

RD-5/RD-3(b): no prior rider consent for this second turn-off (driver's own statement F10 says it was GPS rerouting, disclosed after the fact); RD-4 fails as no incident within 300 m of the optimal route on the replaced section (F13) and speed bands were 5/4, never 1–2 (F11, F12); RD-2 refund of extra km applies.

rejected_claims.reason: Aggregate +8.5 km excess includes the exempted first segment (F3); only the unexempted F4 extra_km is refunded per RD-2.
Speed band 5 (40–49 km/h) on BKE is not band 1/2 and is not an incident record, so it cannot exempt a segment under RD-4.
Driver's route upheld count is 0 in 90 d, so RD-6 flag_account is not triggered.
